business_problem: Michelin’s enterprise ERP was too complex and expensive for newly acquired small and midsize businesses, slowing onboarding and limiting its ability to standardize processes and reporting across subsidiaries.
solution_summary: Michelin standardized ERP for acquired small and midsize businesses on Dynamics 365 Business Central rather than forcing them onto the company’s heavyweight core ERP. The cloud rollout packages financial management, sales, and supply-chain capabilities in a simpler SaaS environment that Michelin’s central IT team can deploy in 6 to 12 months, integrate with Microsoft 365 and Power Platform, and localize with partner COSMO CONSULT. Michelin also connects Business Central to Power BI to build a stronger data repository and reporting layer across subsidiaries operating in multiple currencies and countries. This gives newly acquired agencies a faster path to standard processes and analytics while reducing IT complexity and keeping the environment interoperable with Michelin’s broader Microsoft stack.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Business Central
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud ERP used by Michelin’s smaller businesses for financial, sales, and supply-chain processes.

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Supplies the productivity environment that Michelin wanted Business Central to interoperate with securely.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Extends the ERP environment with interoperable low-code capabilities inside Michelin’s Microsoft stack.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Builds the shared reporting and analytics layer on top of Business Central data.

data_flow: Subsidiary financial, sales, and supply-chain data is managed in Dynamics 365 Business Central, then published into Power BI for analytics while users work from the surrounding Microsoft 365 and Power Platform environment.
integration_points: COSMO CONSULT deployment and localization support
business_outcome: Michelin can deploy ERP more quickly for acquired businesses, scale reporting across subsidiaries, and achieve faster sales ramp-up with less IT overhead than its enterprise ERP required.
